SET @prov_c='%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmpz_diag_opd;
CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmpz_diag_opd(
KEY (hospcode),
KEY (pid),
KEY (cid),
KEY (date_serv)
) AS
SELECT
* 
FROM tmp_diag_opd d
WHERE SUBSTR(d.DIAGCODE,1,3) BETWEEN 'E10' AND 'E14' 
AND d.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d;

call CtCol('hdc','s_dm_visit_screen','ill_visit_seq','ill_visit_cover','int(10) DEFAULT 0');	

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_dm_visit_screen (
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	visit_pid int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	visit_seq int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	ill int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	ill_visit int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	ill_visit_cover int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	target int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result int(10) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
DELETE FROM s_dm_visit_screen  WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);


INSERT IGNORE INTO s_dm_visit_screen  
(
SELECT
@id,h.hoscode as 'hospcode' ,CONCAT(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,visit_pid
,visit_seq
,ill
,ill_visit
,ill_visit_cover
,target
,result
FROM
chospital h LEFT JOIN
(
SELECT
hospcode
,COUNT(DISTINCT hospcode,pid) 'visit_pid'
,COUNT(DISTINCT hospcode,pid,seq) 'visit_seq'
FROM
tmpz_diag_opd t2
GROUP BY HOSPCODE
) d  ON h.hoscode=d.hospcode
LEFT JOIN 
(
SELECT
hospcode
,COUNT(DISTINCT cid) 'target'
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(risk in(0,1,2),cid,NULL)) 'result'
FROM
 t_person_dm_screen s
	LEFT JOIN cage ca ON s.age_y=ca.age
WHERE ca.groupcode3560 in(3,4)
GROUP BY HOSPCODE
) s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode
LEFT JOIN
(
SELECT
t1.hospcode
,COUNT(DISTINCT t1.cid) 'ill'
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t1.hospcode=t2.hospcode,CONCAT(t2.hospcode,'-',t2.pid),NULL)) 'ill_visit'
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t2.hospcode is not null ,CONCAT(t2.cid),NULL))  'ill_visit_cover'
FROM
t_dmht t1
LEFT JOIN tmpz_diag_opd t2  ON t1.cid=t2.cid
WHERE t1.type_dx in(2,3) AND t1.typearea IN(1,3)
GROUP BY t1.hospcode
) c ON h.hoscode=c.hospcode
WHERE  h.hdc_regist=1 AND h.provcode in(@prov_c) 
GROUP BY h.HOSCODE
);

- การคัดกรองประเมินผลจากแฟ้ม NCDScreen
- ผู้ป่วยที่ขึ้นทะเบียนในเขตรับผิดชอบ ประมวลผลจากแฟ้ม Chronic ,Diagnosis_opd ,Diagnosis_ipd และ Person
- การเข้าถึงบริการในเขตรับผิดชอบ หมายถึง ผู้ป่วยที่ขึ้นทะเบียนในเขตรับผิดชอบมารับบริการที่หน่วยบริการตนเอง ส่วนนอกเขตรับผิดชอบ คือ รับบริการที่หน่วยบริการอื่นในจังหวัด
- ผู้ป่วยรับบริการผู้ป่วยนอก ประมวลผลจากแฟ้ม Diagnosis_opd รหัสการวินิจฉัย 3 หลักแรกเป็น E10 ถึง E14

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT     concat(chospital_regis.hoscode) as areacode,     chospital_regis.hosname as areaname,     sum(target) AS target,     sum(result) AS result,     sum(visit_pid) AS visit_pid,     sum(visit_seq) AS visit_seq,     sum(ill) AS ill,     sum(ill_visit) AS ill_visit,     sum(ill_visit_cover) AS ill_visit_cover,     sum(ill_visit_cover - ill_visit) AS ill_visit_out FROM     {{S_TABLE}} as s     LEFT JOIN chospital_regis ON s.hospcode = chospital_regis.hoscode     LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE     s.id = {{REPORT_ID}}     AND LEFT(s.areacode, 2) not IN('99')     AND s.b_year IN( SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', 1), SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', -1) )     AND chospital_regis.hostype IN(5, 6, 7, 11, 12, 15)     AND chospital_regis.hdc_regist = 1     AND chospital_regis.status = '1'     AND (chospital_regis.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}})     AND (chospital_regis.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}})     AND (chospital_regis.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})     AND (chospital_regis.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})     AND (chospital_regis.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}})     AND (chospital_regis.hoscode = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}})     AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})     AND (chospital_regis.dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' = {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})     AND (chospital_regis.mcode = {{MINISTRY_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{MINISTRY_CODE}})     AND ( left(areacode, 2) = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}     ) GROUP BY     chospital_regis.hoscode ORDER BY
